title: ChineseHarm-Bench: A Chinese Harmful Content Detection Benchmark
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable as the benchmark does not measure aspects of religion/faith. The benchmark measures harmful content detection across six secular categories: Gambling, Pornography, Abuse, Fraud, Illicit Ads, and Non-violation, based on Chinese laws and regulations.
findings: No findings related to religion are present in the paper.
